key.name: popup-shortcut
key.description: Opens the Copyveil popup. Onboarding offers to switch it to Super+V.

key.name: capture-paused
key.description: While on, copies aren't sent to Copyveil. Pasting and clearing the clipboard after a Secret's Expiry keep working.

key.name: take-super-v
key.summary: Take Super+V from the notification list
key.description: Set by onboarding when the user agrees. GNOME binds Super+V and Super+M to the notification list; Copyveil then removes only Super+V, and gives it back when the extension is disabled.

key.name: took-super-v
key.summary: Super+V was taken from the notification list
key.description: Internal: whether the extension removed Super+V and owes it back. Survives a crash so the binding is always returned.

key.name: paste-pin-1
key.description: Pastes the Item in Pin slot 1 without opening the History. Pin slots hold only Plain Items, so this can never paste a secret (ADR 0004).
